Tracelink Interview Experience
Name: Shaunak Raiker
Branch:Computer Engineering
Company:Tracelink
Role: Software Engineering Intern
Details:
CPI criteria:8
Stipend:₹35,000 per month.
Location:Mumbai/Pune
About the Company:

Tracelink is a USA based company which manages pharmaceutical
supply chains. Every medicine has a unique number which is generated
on the basis of some rules and there are a lot of strict regulations
related to handling medicines. After the medicines are manufactured
and number is given they travel from manufacturer to different
warehouses
and
different
countries
where
it
further
goes
to
wholesalers and finally to customers. In this process it is necessary to
track and trace each medicine as some of them can expire/get
damaged/spoiled etc. So Tracelink helps managing its clients’ supply
chains by maintaining the registry of whole process and creating serial
numbers and helping in the tracking and tracing. Also there are a set of
rules to be followed which vary from country to country so Tracelink
also helps in abiding the rules and regulations. Apart from these major
functions tracelink also helps to connect manufacturers to distributors
and wholesalers so that all the medicines are tracked and necessary
medicines can be sent to places where they are needed.
Online assessment:
The online assessment took place on 26th November,2023
Online assessment was divided into two sections:
1.Web development MCQs: Total(10-15 mcqs)
Total time allocated:1hr
These sections consisted of mcqs on a wide variety of topics based on
Node Js, Javascript,React,Angular which were asked in the form of
some real life scenarios.

2.Coding Questions: Total(3qs)
Difficulty level: Medium to hard
a)This question was based on the Graph Topic.
We were given a bunch of cities and a bunch of roads connecting all the
cities.We had to find a no of starting points such that we are able to
visit all the cities
It was kind of similar to this:
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/hamiltonian-cycle/
b)This was based on the LinkedList topic
We were a bunch of k linked lists and each of these k linked list
contained some nodes.
The idea here was mainly to sort all the k linked lists by using the
brute force way.
c)It was based on the Binary Search on ans topic
It was kind of similar to this problem:
https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1301/B
Out of all the students who gave the online assessment,
14 students were selected for the interviews
The interview was conducted offline at their andheri branch
Interview:
The interviews were scheduled on 1st December,2023

Entire interview consisted of three rnds:
1.Technical Interview 1
2.Technical Interview 2
3.HR Round
1.Technical Interview 1:
Questions which were asked to me are as follows:
1)Introduce yourself
2)Explain about your project in short
3)Explain about the real life usage of the graph data structure
4)Explain about the internal working of a map data structure
5)Coding questions:
Given an array of elements find the first element which occurs at least
k times
The question was similar to this:
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/first-element-occurring-k-times-array
/
6)Puzzle:
We have a mouse and a pig.
Mouse speaks lies on Monday,Tuesday and Wednesday and on the other
days he speaks the truth.
Pig speaks lies on Thursday,Friday and Saturday and on the other days
he speaks the truth.
Both mouse and pig say that they lied yesterday.
Then what day is today?

The question was similar to this:
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzle-the-lion-and-the-unicorn/
Students were selected for the further rounds on a rolling basis
Approximately 7 students were selected for the second rnd
2.Technical Rnd-2:
This round was completely focused on projects and some hr questions
Questions asked to me were:
1)Give an introduction about yourself
2)Explain in depth about your projects
3)Draw the database model of one of your projects
4)Some hr questions were asked:
a)What was the biggest challenge u faced during your project?
b)What are some of your strengths?
c)What are some of your weaknesses?
This is one of the toughest hr qs.Prepare it properly :)
d)How would u resolve a conflict between team members?
e)If one of your team member is not contributing to the project,how
would u handle such a situation?
Out of this 7 students,4 students were selected for the hr round
3.HR Round:
Questions which were asked to me in this round are as follows:

1)Give a brief introduction about yourself
2)Why should we hire you?
3)Who is your role model?
4)What are your strengths and weaknesses?
The results were declared the same day and I was one of the 3
students who was selected for this internship.
Preparation:
1.Data Structures & Algorithms:
a)I practiced A-Z DSA Sheet sheet by Striver. It’s a wonderful sheet
if you are a beginner and it has a variety of questions based from easy,
medium to difficult level.
b)In case, you don’t have much time for preparation, you can definitely
try SDE Sheet by Striver. It consists around 180-190 question
c)Try to solve Leetcode daily without fail everyday
d)For
topics
like Recursion ,Binary Trees, Binary Search Trees,
DynamicProgramming, Graphs, I watched TakeUForward channel taught
by Striver (Raja Vikramaditya)
For topics like monotonic stack,priority queue,dp i would suggest Aditya
Vermas channel as well
e)LeetCode organizes a Weekly Contest every Sunday at 8:00 AM and a
BiWeekly Contest once in two weeks(Saturday) at 8:00 PM. Try giving
these contests as you will gain interview experience while solving the

problems because the timer on the screen does create extra pressure
during interviews.You will learn time management as well by practicing
these contests.
2)Object Oriented Programming
a)For c++ oops i would strongly recommend watching the entire playlist
of Code With Harry on OOPS.
b)Also, learn how to implement OOPs in your coding language. You may
be asked to demonstrate it in your interview.
c)I would also strongly recommend to study java oops as well
It may be asked in some interviews irrespective of whether u know java
or not and was one of the main reasons for my rejection in one of my
earlier interview :(
3)Operating Systems:
a)I had watched the entire playlist of Unacademy on OS and had made
notes of the same for the same.The notes made during the semester
exams would be more than sufficient for OS
b)Also prepare OS interview questions of gfg:
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/operating-systems-interview-questi
ons/
4)DBMS:
a)I had watched the entire playlist of Unacademy on DBMS and had
made notes of the same for the same .
The notes made during the semester exams would be more than
sufficient for DBMS.
b)Also prepare DBMS interview questions on gfg or interview bit:

https://www.interviewbit.com/dbms-interview-questions/
5)JAVA
a)Irrespective of whether u know C++ or not,I would highly recommend
learning java as well.
b)I had watched the playlist of CodeWithHarry for java
c)Also prepare Java interview questions on gfg or interview bit:
https://www.interviewbit.com/java-interview-questions/
6)System Design:
a)If u have additional time left during your preparation,I would
recommend learning system design as well.
b)This topic is asked by a very few companies and mostly depends on
your luck whether u will be asked a qs on it or not.
c)However in one of my earlier interviews i was asked a qs on system
design and i wasn't able to ans it which become one of the reasons for
my rejection in that interview :(
d)U can learn system design concepts from below site:
https://takeuforward.org/system-design/complete-system-design-roa
dmap-with-videos-for-sdes/
7)Competitive Programming:
a)It is not compulsory but doing it gives you an edge over the other
candidates in an online assessment.(At Least most of the time :) )

b)For this u can regularly give contests on codechef and codeforces
https://www.codechef.com/practice
https://codeforces.com/problemset
8)Puzzles:
a)I was asked a puzzle during my first round and luckily i was able
to solve it without any prior practice ;)
b)I would suggest to solve some of the most frequently asked
puzzles
to
boost
confidence
and
have an edge over other
candidates
c)U can practice them on
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzles/
9)Aptitude:
a)This is one of the most frequently asked topic in any online
assessment.
b)I would suggest practicing aptitude questions from here:
https://www.indiabix.com/
c)Also u can refer to this CareerRide Youtube channel:
10)Company Research:

a)Before any interview,make sure u research about the company in
depth and try to find out everything about the purpose,culture etc.
b)Try to connect each of the ans to your hr questions with the
research u have done about the company.
c)Make an impression on them such that u know everything about the
company.
d)Make sure u ask questions to the interviewer after each round this
puts a positive impression on the interviewer.
e)This mostly becomes the differentiating factor between u and the
other candidates so prepare it thoroughly.
f)U can prepare the hr questions from here:
https://www.interviewbit.com/hr-interview-questions/
Some additional tips:
1)Always try to stay calm during the interview
2)If u dont know the answer to the question, just let the interviewer
know that u dont know rather than giving some dumb responses xD.
3)Try to speak out loud and clearly during the interview and try to have
a smile on your face during the interview
4)Don't get depressed
if you are not selected and try to learn from
your mistakes.I myself got rejected in three other interviews before
cracking this one.
5)Keep your resume up to date with all the projects.
6)Last but not least:

Have faith in your preparation and most importantly have faith in
yourself.
Good Luck!!
In case of any further doubts u can connect with me on
LinkedIn
